answer: The design leans on escrowed payment for graded work, voided if the audit panel is not diverse, rewards vest against future work. Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short. The saffron holds work receipts rather than names, so the karst of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. The ocean of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name.
